instruction: Please configure LibreOffice Writer as my default word processor on this Ubuntu machine.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting LibreOffice Writer as default word processor. Evaluator checks xdg-mime settings for document MIME types (vnd.ms-word, vnd.oasis.opendocument.text) to verify libreoffice-writer.desktop is registered. Similar complexity to original VLC task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts default word processor via xdg-mime queries for relevant document MIME types (vnd.ms-word, vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, vnd.oasis.opendocument.text, rtf)
Metric check_include_exclude correctly verifies that 'libreoffice-writer.desktop' is present in the result string
Data flow is correct: getter returns single string (most common default app) -> metric checks if expected string is in result -> works correctly
Complete verification coverage: evaluator checks if LibreOffice Writer is registered as default, which directly verifies the instruction requirement
Edge cases handled appropriately: returns 'unknown' if no default set, uses Counter to handle multiple MIME types with different defaults
